name: Serial Log Monitor
description: Capture DUT UART output, verify required/forbidden patterns, or open an interactive terminal.
help_text: Captures UART output using the Target DUT Control Port selected in the top Hardware Connection toolbar and validates required/forbidden patterns (PASS/FAIL). You can also open an interactive terminal to send commands directly.

criteria_help.send_command: Optional text command to transmit to the DUT before listening (e.g. 'AT\r\n').
criteria_help.required_patterns: Patterns that MUST appear in the UART output. Comma or newline separated.
criteria_help.forbidden_patterns: Patterns that cause immediate FAIL if detected (e.g. 'ERROR', 'HardFault').
criteria_help.save_to_file: Save all captured lines to a file in the trace/ directory.
